dashboard.welcome_description: Basic information about your hosting account.
settings.password_description: Change the password for SSH login and for this panel - the same password works in both places.
settings.password_forced_hint: You must set a new password before you can use the rest of the panel.
settings.password_hint: Required: at least 8 characters. Recommended: at least 16 characters, upper and lower case letters, digits, special characters.
settings.error_mismatch: The passwords you entered do not match.
cron.add_description: Schedule commands to run automatically at specific times. Use absolute paths - output is captured in your account's cron logs.
cron.template_hint: Inserts a ready-made job. WordPress/Laravel need the highlighted placeholder (domain/app folder) replaced with your own - the rest is ready to save as-is.
cron.schedule_hint: Format: minute hour day month weekday
cron.php_paths_none: No PHP CLI binaries detected on this server.
sites.manage_description: Enter the domain without "www." - choose the redirect direction separately (exception: "No redirect").
sites.domain_hint: Without "www." - with the "No redirect" option you can also enter the full www. domain (e.g. www.example.com) as a single, standalone domain.
sites.template_reverseproxy_hint: Run your app locally (e.g. Python: venv + gunicorn/uvicorn on 127.0.0.1:PORT, keep it alive via a systemd --user unit; Node: npm start on a port), then enter that port above.
sites.template_php_pool_hint: PHP-FPM pool size (number of worker processes) is sized automatically from your package's RAM limit.
sites.wp_install_hint: Once you pick a language, WordPress is downloaded from wordpress.org and extracted into public/ - the index.php/info.php placeholder is NOT created in that case.
sites.limit_reached: You have reached the site limit from your package ({limit}).
sites.php_restart_confirm: Restart PHP-FPM worker processes for this version? This reloads ALL sites on the same PHP version (not just this one), gracefully - no active connections are dropped.
sites.confirm_delete: Delete site {domain}? The Caddy config AND ALL FILES under ~/domains/{domain} will be PERMANENTLY deleted. This cannot be undone.
sites.empty: You don't have any site yet.
sites.config_edit_hint: Below is the full, raw Caddy config for this site - you can edit it by hand and add your own blocks/directives. The Compression/Security checkboxes above only insert/remove specific lines within this same content. Click "Check" before "Activate" to validate your changes without deploying them.
databases.manage_description: A database is always named <your_login>_<name> - one identifier for both the database and its user.
databases.no_engines: No database engine is installed on this server yet.
databases.confirm_delete: Delete this database? This cannot be undone.
databases.empty: You don't have any database yet.
redis.manage_description: A private Redis instance for your account, max 256 MB. Local-only (no network access) - password is optional.
redis.not_available: Redis is not installed on this server yet.
redis.contact_admin_hint: To increase the Redis RAM limit, contact your Administrator.
python.manage_description: A private virtual environment (venv) for your account - pick a Python version, create the venv and install a framework.
python.no_versions_hint: No Python version was detected on this server - contact your Administrator.
python.confirm_recreate_venv: A venv already exists - creating a new one will delete it along with all installed packages. Continue?
python.confirm_delete_venv: Delete the venv along with all installed packages?
python.reverseproxy_hint: To expose the running app under a domain, add a site using the Reverse Proxy template and point it at this port.
ssh.connection_description: Use these details in your SSH/SFTP client to connect to your website files.
ssh.keys_description: Manage SSH keys to connect without a password.
ssh.key_hint: Add the public key from your OpenSSH key pair here (for example: ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub or ~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub).
ssh.keys_empty: No SSH key added yet - password login is active.
backup.settings_description: Choose where your backups (restic) go and set the repository's encryption password.
backup.repo_type_local_hint: Backups go to ~/backup/repo on the same disk as your account - zero extra setup, but weaker protection (a disk failure affects both your data and its backup).
backup.jobs_description: Choose what to back up (sites and/or databases), the schedule, and how many recent snapshots to keep.
backup.no_sites_hint: No sites eligible for backup (Reverse Proxy sites have no public/ directory).
backup.keep_last_hint: Older snapshots beyond this limit are removed after every successful backup (restic forget --prune).
backup.snapshots_description: Snapshots from your restic repository. Restoring writes files to a NEW ~/backup/restore/... directory - it never overwrites your live site.
backup.confirm_restore: Restore this snapshot? Files go to a new ~/backup/restore/... directory (your live site is not overwritten).
backup.snapshots_empty: No snapshots yet - run a backup job to create the first one.
backup.snapshots_need_repo: Configure a repository in Settings first.
